'''March 2002 Modesto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Modesto, California on 30 March 2002. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3546">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-01-modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberriesd3546/ modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberries], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 1 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-01-modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberriesd3546/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Modesto, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
